get.description: Streams message state and run progress. Private threads also emit selection events with trainingIds and trainingLabels, initially and whenever their selected runs change. Screen events are sent only to the asking user and tab. Private analyst threads also send `draft` events, {runId, messageId, text}: the answer as written so far, for the asker only, sent when it changes (`text` is empty once the run is over). The draft stays until the answer is published as a message, so a reader can hold it up until a message replying to `messageId` arrives. The message-updates event carries revisioned patches for reactions and unsent messages, independently of the message sequence cursor. Reconnects replay persisted mutations.

200.description: Updated message, including revision, unsentAt and reactions. Unsent messages contain no original text or attachment references.

post.summary: Ask your assistant again with other words
post.description: Only your latest question in your private chat with an assistant, and only a text one. The edited text is sent as a new question (the body is the same as sending one, with a new clientId); the old question and its answer are retired: hidden from the thread and from what the assistant is told, and kept in the run's history. A repeated request with the same clientId finishes what the first did not reach and changes nothing else.

400.description: Invalid input

projectId.description: For a `project` discussion. Not accepted for an `assistant` chat: send the project with the question instead (`SendMessage.context`).

paperId.description: Not accepted for an `assistant` chat. Send the paper with the question instead (`SendMessage.context`).

userIds.description: Contacts from rosters the caller may currently read; membership is rechecked

CreateConversation.description: A private (`assistant`) chat is one per person and assistant: asking again returns the chat that exists. What a question is about is sent with the question (`SendMessage.context`), never when the chat is opened.

screen.description: The asking private panel's page hint, verified with project-scoped tools before use. Optional actions advertise frames currently loaded by the page. Stored only in the pending job outbox and run, not in public message content.

labels.description: Optional frame names, in the same order as ids. Untrusted display labels.

allowActions.description: The desktop side panel sends true by default. Without true, the page is read-only context and no navigation/action tool is offered.

context.description: What a question to the analyst is about, for a private (`assistant`) chat: a project and some of its runs, or a paper on its own. Checked as the sender when the message is sent (a project or paper they cannot read is refused) and kept with the message, so one chat can hold questions about many things. Leave it out for a general question.

SendMessage.description: A message needs nonempty body text or at least one attachment. In assistant threads, image attachments are sent to the configured model for visual analysis; image-only messages ask it to describe what it sees. Other attachment types are supplied as metadata only.

publicKey.description: The VAPID public key a browser subscribes with. Made by the server on first start unless the operator supplies one.

endpoint.description: A public https push service address. Plain http, IP addresses and internal host names are refused.

mode.description: How far calls reach on this server: a hosted relay, the operator's own relay, STUN only, or the local network only.

relay.description: False means calls between some networks will not connect.

deviceId.description: Made up by the browser per page load; tells one person's tabs apart.

data.description: One of: a session description (offer or answer, at most 50,000 characters of SDP), an ICE candidate, or a state change (screen, camera, showing).

emoji.description: Set your reaction or null to remove it. One reaction per person per message.
